payout_quote: LA County: community election workers earn $100 per day served plus $80 after completing all training requirements, with a possible $100 stipend for qualified bilingual workers; may serve up to 10 days (Election Day plus early voting).
steps: Apply as a community election worker with LA County Registrar-Recorder
Complete all training requirements ($80 training pay)
Serve Election Day (6 a.m.–9 p.m.) and/or early-voting days (9 a.m.–8 p.m.)
Receive $100 per day served, plus training pay and possible $100 language stipend
catches: Election Day is a 15-hour day (6 a.m.–9 p.m.).
Training pay requires completing ALL training requirements.
Work is limited to the election period, up to 10 days.
biggest_catch: $100/day for up to 15-hour Election Day shifts — roughly $6.70/hour on Election Day itself.
eligibility: Eligible LA County residents 18+ (students 16+ in student program).
timing: Paid per day served during the election period.
